subject: Azure Marketplace: offer creation checklist + publisher account ownership
messages:
From: Sally Price <sally.price@contoso.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Leah O'Neill <leah.oneill@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure listing — next steps for Contoso (offer details)

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Contoso team is keen to get the offer into the Azure Marketplace before year-end. We flagged a few gaps on our side that will need coordination:

- Which Redwood account will be the official publisher on the portal? We need a named contact for invite flows and verification.
- Do you have a canonical offer manifest we can start filling for pricing and SKUs?
- Any known technical gate items that typically trip verification (cert thumbprints, private connectivity notes)?

Attached is our initial product brief. Can we set a short runbook to hand off publisher ownership and confirm portal invites? Leah — looping you in for any Microsoft-specific publisher requirements we should be aware of.

Appreciate a quick reply with owners and a proposed 30-min slot.

Best,
Sally Price
Head of Partnerships, Contoso Ltd.
attachments: contoso-product-brief.pdf

From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
To: Sally Price <sally.price@contoso.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, Leah O'Neill <leah.oneill@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure listing — next steps for Contoso (offer details)

Sally, thanks — and great to meet yesterday. Quick answers and proposed owners: 

- Publisher owner: Jordan Blake (jordan.blake@redwood.ai) — I will accept the portal invite and shepherd the verification. Marcus will own the billing/manifest mapping.
- Manifest: I attached a Redwood starter manifest (azure-offer-manifest-v1.json) that maps our SKU model to Azure SKU templates. Fill Contoso product details into the highlighted fields and send back.
- Technical gate items we typically see: cert thumbprint for SaaS single-tenant offers, redirect URI validation for OAuth apps, and the publisher verification docs (company registration, point of contact). Also confirm whether any IP allowlists are required for your environment.

Proposed runbook: 30-min sync tomorrow (Thu 26th) — agenda: (1) portal invite flow, (2) manifest walkthrough, (3) tech gate checklist and timetable. Marcus, Hannah — can you join?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure listing — next steps for Contoso (offer details)

Hi Sally — added a couple of concrete notes after Jordan's template:

- Pricing model: Contoso should confirm whether you want a subscription-based SKU or usage-based metering. The manifest supports both but the SKUs differ (see manifest: pricing.stanza).
- Co-sell: If you plan to pursue Microsoft co-sell, Leah — what artifacts are required on the publisher profile? (e.g., case studies, co-sell readiness form)
- Timeline: If Contoso returns completed manifest + legal PO by 12/3, we can submit for technical validation the week of 12/6.

I've attached a short checklist: Contoso-publisher-approval-note.pdf (internal note on docs we need).

On the calendar: 12/26 09:30 PT — oops that's wrong date, meant 11/26 09:30 PT — Jordan, Hannah, Marcus confirmed?

Marissa Cole
Sales Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Leah O'Neill <leah.oneill@microsoft.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sally.price@contoso.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure listing — next steps for Contoso (offer details)

Thanks all — quick clarification from Microsoft side:

- Publisher verification: We need the company legal name, DUNS (if available), and a designated publisher contact that can receive tenant invites. Jordan as publisher contact is fine.
- Co-sell readiness: Please upload a 1-page case study and confirm the sales motion. Co-sell artifacts go in the partner center under the "Co-sell readiness" tab — I can share a template after this thread.
- Technical validation: For SaaS offers we run a smoke test that includes OAuth redirect checks and sample API calls from a Microsoft validation tenant. We will ask Contoso to provide a test tenant or credentials for the smoke test.

I'll add the co-sell template link and a publisher checklist after the meeting. Happy to join tomorrow's sync to accelerate.

-Leah
Partner PM, Microsoft Azure Marketplace
leah.oneill@microsoft.com
